# Brief

Hand-written, no brief: the v0.5 clinic load fixture, the six clinic
domains (`vet-core`, `vet-housing`, `vet-scheduling`, `vet-lab`,
`vet-machinery`, `vet-portal`) loaded through `gmctl load-data` and their
coherence checks, uncomposed and load only, deployed by
`run-short-test.sh` (wave 3's gate, spec D407). Not a game.
